snippet.title: Build Brutal Guns - Flashes of Chaos Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Flashes of Chaos Demo is out now on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3806250/Flashes_of_Chaos_Demo/

Flashes of Chaos is A fast-paced roguelike top-down shooter about building brutal guns. Collect ammunition cards, add modifiers, and load them into your weapon of choice to create your own unique experience of pure, adrenaline-fueled destruction.
